1377. 15. August. 0. �?0. — Marquard von Mödling überträgt auf den Abt und Convent des Klosters zu Hohenfurt alle seine Rechte an dem Dorfe Buggaus.

Ego Marquardus dictus Metlyn tenore presencium publice recognosco, quod omne jus, quod hactenus vna cum heredibus meis in villa Bukauxs habui, quam a nobili domina Anna de Lypa cum om nibus suis pertinenciis iusto empciouis tytulo comparaui, prout in littera super hoc coufecta plenius coutinetur, idem ius in religiosos viros dominos abbatem et conuentum monasterii Altiuadensis pre sentibus transfero et transfundo pretacto juri cum heredibus meis penitus renuncians el omnino. In cuius rei robur et euidens testi moniiim sigillum meum presentibus est appensum et in testimonium lucidius sigilla dominorum meorum nobilium Petri et Johannis de Rosenberg necnon famosorum clientum Nicolai de Malotyn Nicolay de Rzebnowytz presentibus sunt appensa. Datum anno domini mil- lesimo trecentesimo septuagesimo septimo die assumpcionis beate Marie virginis gloriose. entries.english: Marquard von Mödling transfers to the abbot and convent of Hohenfurt Abbey all his rights in the village of Buggaus. I, Marquard called Metlyn, publicly acknowledge that I transfer and convey to the religious lords, the abbot and convent of Hohenfurt, all rights that I have held with my heirs in Bukauxs, acquired by lawful purchase from Anna de Lipa with its appurtenances; I wholly renounce them. My seal and, as further testimony, those of Peter and Johann von Rosenberg and Nicolaus de Malotyn and Nicolaus de Rzebnowytz are attached. Given on the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary, 1377. Four small seals hang from parchment strips; the Rzebnowitz seal is missing.
